en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a tree-lined street with a rustic pavilion or inn beside the road. The building has large arched windows, latticework details, and a picket fence, with several people standing or sitting in front. The surrounding area appears to be a wooded city park or forest edge. A tram or trolley can be seen in the background on the right. Printed text along the bottom reads the city name and describes the scene as a part of the city forest with a forest tavern.
